title: feat(mixlab): no tick-1 labeling fires the chiral pair
science: Exhaustive negative census, not a probe cell: over ALL eight {+,-} label assignments to the three tick-1 axis sites on the two-cube, the July-3 k=3 chiral pair fires nowhere - N_new=0 in every case, N_fire=0, no lex-first firing labeling. The mechanism is proved: every unread site after tick 1 has at most 2 locked neighbours (max_locked=2), so its six-tuple carries at least four '0' letters and can never be handed fully-mixed. Strengthens #6634 from one labeling to all eight.
